headline: TD Cowen Maintains Buy on Oracle, Lowers Price Target to $240
Wall Street Is Divided on Oracle Stock: AI Cloud Upside Meets $95 Billion Debt Pressure
summary: Oracle stock is in focus as analysts debate its multi-billion-dollar AI cloud infrastructure push against rising debt risks and Michael Burry's short position.

headline: $100 Invested In Oracle 20 Years Ago Would Be Worth This Much Today
summary: Oracle (NYSE:ORCL) has outperformed the market over the past 20 years by 2.3% on an annualized basis producing an average annual return of 11.54%. Currently, Oracle has a market capitalization of $406.81 billion.
